title: Kris Krohn lists Utah estate with a disappearing pool
summary_full: Kris Krohn has listed his expansive mansion in Utah for $13.95 million. This sprawling estate features a unique hydraulic indoor pool that transforms into a ballroom. The property also includes a commercial-grade gym, spa facilities, and an extensive garage for car collections. The mansion is designed for full-time living and hosting large events. It is expected to attract entrepreneurs and high-level professionals looking for a versatile space.
